scope: Version and equipment checks for new generated adaptations. These references do not establish official-frame fidelity or validate every costume pixel.

facts.supports: The original four classes are Soldier Roland with rifles and Scorpio Turret, Siren Lilith with Phasewalk, Hunter Mordecai with sniper weapons and Bloodwing, and Berserker Brick with fists. A selected ordinary equipped rifle/SMG is a loadout, not an exclusive innate weapon.

facts.access: indexed official strategy-guide sample text read
facts.supports: Original four-character selection and weapon preferences; all four can equip the available weapon types. No later sequel class is transferred.

facts.supports: The gallery identifies original2009 character-art subjects. Individual concept designs are not proof of the final game costume. No claim that full-resolution source art was inspected.

Mordecai original BL1 leather headgear/cowl differs from his later bandanna. This fan profile contains explicitly invented rules and those rules are not adopted. Only the described costume distinction is used.

FuryRoad2015 cast and physical firearms: Furiosa's Chinese Type56 SKS has a scope mount and extra under-stock grip, without bayonet/cleaning rod. Toast handles ammunition and reloads it; she also handles a Glock17. The exact source footage remains authoritative over this secondary identification guide.
Furiosa is missing part of her LEFT arm and wears the physical metal prosthesis. The natural right arm remains human. The renderer must not turn this into an energy weapon.

Jenny Beavan describes Max's worn leather survival costume, Furiosa's prosthetic harness and the wives' pale cloth wrapping. Selected images are adaptations of those versions, without claiming exact frame reconstruction.

Adult Toast and Capable are distinct film identities; old generated Toast's male explorer/goggles are rejected as costume authority. Toast is Zoe Kravitz with short dark hair; Capable is Riley Keough with long red hair.
